stories.title: Hero Motors shares soar 8% as Q2 net profit more than doubles to Rs 10 crore
stories.summary: Hero Motors shares jumped after the company reported a 115% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 10.2 crore. However, net profit fell 31% sequentially, while total expenses increased 19% YoY to Rs 307.06 crore.

stories.title: Bank of America hit with $1.2bn fine for money laundering failings
stories.summary: Bank of America has been fined $1.2bn (£910m) for failing to detect potential money laundering and other illegal activity, the US Treasury Department said on Tuesday. The announcement came less 24 hours before Bank of America was due to announce its quarterly earnings on Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
stories.summary: Only five years into its journey, Character.AI, which lets users create AI characters and have conversations with them, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, following a slew of lawsuits and struggles to scale its popular platform. In a court document, the company said it had assets and liabilities between $50 million and $100 million.

stories.title: IMF warns of risks from AI boom and debt, but raises forecast for world growth
stories.summary: The international body slightly upgraded its outlook for the world economy, but warned that risks of an AI-related market correction and job losses because of the technology, as well as government debt, remain concerns. That's up from its July forecast for three per cent growth and well below the 3.5 per cent expansion in 2025.

stories.summary: Fuel theft is leaving Kelowna vehicle owners facing more than an empty tank, with some discovering holes drilled directly into their vehicles’ fuel tanks. He estimates the repair could cost between $1,000 and $2,000, although he is still waiting for an official estimate.

stories.title: Russian missile strikes hit Kyiv power plant and apartment block
stories.summary: A Russian ballistic missile struck the Darnytska CHP‑4 power plant, a key facility supplying heating and electricity to Kyiv, and also hit a nearby residential building. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attack came without early warning, while Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported two deaths and 21 injuries in the apartment block. The strike occurred amid multiple recent Russian attacks on the city.
stories.why: Damage to a major power plant threatens Kyiv’s energy supply and civilian safety.

stories.title: What we know about the man who died falling from a Six Flags rollercoaster
stories.summary: A man has died after falling from a rollercoaster at a Six Flags amusement park on Monday in the US state of Georgia. The Cobb County Police Department said the incident at the Six Flags Over Georgia park happened just before 16:00 local time (20:00 GMT) on Monday.
